title: The Wi‑Fi Router Myth

scenes.text: The first public Wi‑Fi hotspot opened in 1992 at a coffee shop.
Many believe early Wi‑Fi used the same 2.4 GHz band as modern routers.
scenes.label: Early Wi‑Fi same band myth

scenes.text: Actually the 1992 system operated on the 2.5 GHz ISM band, later standardized to 2.4 GHz for compatibility.
scenes.label: Used 2.5 GHz ISM band

scenes.text: Understanding the original band explains why early routers had limited range.
scenes.label: Band limits range

description: The coffee‑shop Wi‑Fi story is famous, but the frequency myth persists. Learn the actual band used and why early routers behaved differently. Follow for more simple tech explanations.
